semantics.rust_signature: fn tensor_view_exact_native(input: &Tensor, specification: TensorViewSpec<'_>, cancellation: &CancellationToken) -> Result<Tensor, ShapeLayoutTransformPartOneError>
semantics.alias_rule: read-only compatible-stride shape views and checked dtype reinterpretations share input storage
semantics.shape_rule: shape form permits one inferred dimension; dtype form rescales the last dimension, strides, and storage offset under PyTorch alignment rules
semantics.dtype_rule: shape form preserves dtype; dtype form reinterprets exact bytes without numeric conversion
semantics.layout_rule: TensorDescriptor is the sole compatible-stride, dtype-reinterpretation, alignment, and storage-bounds validator
semantics.numeric_rule: no arithmetic; dtype form is byte exact
semantics.cancellation_points: before specification validation and before returning the view
semantics.vjp_rule: shape view has a checked inverse view; dtype reinterpretation is forward-only and non-differentiable
semantics.jvp_rule: shape view applies the identical view to the tangent; dtype reinterpretation is forward-only and non-differentiable
